in_english.name: Samad
in_english.meaning: The self-sustaining, independent, and indivisible being who is beyond all duality
in_english.long_meaning: The name Samad is derived from the Arabic root 'S-M-D' which means the self-sustaining, independent, and indivisible being who is beyond all duality. The name Samad is one of the 99 Names of Allah and is mentioned in the Quran. The name Samad signifies the attribute of Allah being self-sustaining, independent, and indivisible. The name Samad is associated with the concept of Tawhid, the oneness of Allah. The name Samad is also associated with the concept of Asma al-Husna, the beautiful names of Allah. The name Samad is a symbol of the unity and oneness of Allah. The name Samad is a reminder of the importance of Tawhid and the rejection of shirk. The name Samad is a name that is deeply rooted in Islamic theology and is used to describe the attributes of Allah.
